AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

The Amazon Agentic WorkSpaces organization is building the future of secure high-performance agentic WorkSpaces Applications environments - environments that span desktops and applications serving knowledge workers, task workers, and automation agents at millions-of-users scale.

## The role The Amazon Agentic WorkSpaces organization is seeking a Software Development Manager to lead the engineering team behind Amazon WorkSpaces Advisor our AI-powered troubleshooting and optimization experience for administrators. We are building agentic solutions that analyze fleet telemetry, diagnose root causes, and recommend or apply fixes - turning problems that once took days of manual investigation into answers delivered in minutes. Our aim is to make virtual desktop and application environments effectively self-diagnosing so administrators spend their time on strategic work instead of chasing symptoms across consoles and logs.

You will lead a team of software engineers building at the intersection of applied AI and large-scale distributed systems. You will own Advisor end to end - expanding the range of problems it can solve, raising the accuracy and trustworthiness of its recommendations, and advancing it from reactive troubleshooting toward proactive detection and self-healing. In addition, your team owns a set of Control Plane Services through which customers provision, configure, and manage their environments where you will be accountable for availability latency security posture and operational health. This role offers the opportunity to build new agentic products from the ground up while operating production services that customers depend on every day. You will influence the technical direction of the team and work across many different technologies and disciplines. You will raise the engineering bar - design rigor, code quality, test coverage, and safe deployment practices - and champion an AI-native automation-first approach to how software gets built and operated using agentic tooling to increase velocity without trading away quality. You will identify technology gaps and opportunities and write effective communications including design documents, tenets, and PR/FAQs. Above all you will hire grow and retain engineers who scale with the business.

About the team
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Fire Safety Manager

Description

Fire Safety & Compliance Management

Fire Safety & Compliance Management Develop, implement, and enforce fire safety policies and procedures in compliance with Taiwan's fire codes and regulations. Conduct fire risk assessments, safety inspections, and audits to identify potential hazards and recommend mitigation strategies. Collaborate with regulatory agencies, authorities having jurisdiction (AHJs), and fire departments to ensure compliance with fire safety laws. Lead fire protection system inspections, maintenance, and performance evaluations to ensure optimal functionality.

Fire Prevention & Risk Mitigation

Fire Prevention & Risk Mitigation Establish and execute fire prevention programs, ensuring best practices are adopted across all facilities. Oversee the design, installation, and maintenance of fire detection, alarm, and suppression systems. Implement hot work permit programs, fire drills, and evacuation plans to ensure operational readiness. Develop and maintain fire load assessments to evaluate and minimize potential fire risks.

Emergency Response & Crisis Management

Emergency Response & Crisis Management Lead the development of fire emergency response plans and conduct regular fire drills. Train employees and emergency response teams on fire safety procedures, evacuation protocols, and fire extinguisher use. Act as a liaison with local emergency services to coordinate emergency response efforts effectively. Develop business continuity strategies related to fire incidents to minimize disruptions and ensure swift recovery.

Fire Safety Training & Awareness

Fire Safety Training & Awareness Design and deliver fire safety training programs for employees, contractors, and facility teams. Ensure all personnel are equipped with knowledge of fire prevention and practices and emergency response protocols. Foster a strong fire safety culture through awareness campaigns and engagement initiatives.

Data Management & Reporting

Data Management & Reporting Maintain comprehensive records of fire incidents, safety inspections, and compliance reports. Analyze fire safety data to identify trends and drive continuous improvement initiatives. Provide executive-level reports and recommendations on fire safety performance and risk reduction strategies.

Qualifications Required:

• Bachelor’s degree in Fire Safety, Fire Science, Engineering, or a related field.
• Minimum of 8 years of fire prevention experience, preferably in a corporate, industrial, or authority having jurisdiction (AHJ) setting.
• Strong knowledge of Taiwan's fire safety regulations, NFPA standards, and global fire codes.
• Experience in fire risk assessment, compliance audits, and emergency planning.
• Proficiency in fire protection system design, maintenance, and evaluation.
• Excellent leadership, problem solving, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred:

• Advanced degree in Fire Science, Engineering or Occupational Safety.
• Certifications such as Certified Fire Protection Specialist (CFPS), NFPA, or equivalent.
• Experience with fire safety technology, AI-enabled fire monitoring, and digital compliance tracking.
• Bilingual proficiency in Mandarin and English.
• Prior experience in multinational corporations or high-risk operational environments.
